tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground: the ledger sheet. Content area, login page, table body.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header rows, the row under the pointer. Never used for cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, tooltips: anything that sits above the sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and marks on surface, surface-sunk, surface-raised and accent-tint (≥10:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, meta lines, inherited ditto marks. Reads on every surface and accent-tint (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Row numbers and marginal notes. Reads on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised (≥4.8:1); not on accent-tint in dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between table rows and list items. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules: under page headers, above table footers, the sidebar edge.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, selects and secondary buttons (≥3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ink blue. The only accent: primary buttons, links, focus ring, selection, unsaved-change markers. Text-safe on every surface (≥6.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, checked checkbox).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the unsaved-changes bar, changed cells. Text on it: ink, ink-muted or accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every control. ≥6.6:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: granted
tokens.usage: Only for a permission that is granted (role check, override check). Never decorative.

tokens.name: granted-tint
tokens.usage: Optional cell wash behind a granted override. Never on its own without the mark.

tokens.name: denied
tokens.usage: Only for denied overrides and destructive actions (Delete role, Disable user). Text-safe on every surface (≥5.2:1).

tokens.name: denied-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash of destructive buttons; cell wash behind a denied override.

tokens.name: on-denied
tokens.usage: Text on a filled destructive button (confirm dialogs only).

families.serif: "IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: One per page: the role name, Users, Sign in.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Large figures in a page header (users holding a role). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page. Never inside a table.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row labels in the matrix, user names in lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons at small size, nav items.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Marginal annotations and row numbers, ink-faint, tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Permission identifiers wherever they appear in running text.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Identifiers in marginal notes and tooltips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its label; label padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding (horizontal), input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a form; toolbar gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and toolbar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margins at 1440px; the row-number gutter width.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top margin above a page title.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, rows, the sidebar, page sections. The ledger is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, role labels, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips only. Nothing on the sheet casts a shadow.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Table and matrix row height at medium density.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: Width of one action column in the permission matrix.

tokens.name: size-rule
tokens.usage: Every rule and control border.
